_help: Source of the subscribable calendar (public/calendar.ics and public/calendar-ru.ics). Edit here, then run `npm run calendar` (it also runs on every `npm start`). Times are Cyprus local time. To cancel one Tuesday add its date to weekly[].cancelled; to cancel a one-off run set its "cancelled": true (keep the entry, so subscribers see it disappear). Never change an "id": calendars match events by it. Weekly series example (add to "weekly" once the regular schedule is set): {"id": "tuesday-run", "day": "TU", "from": "2026-11-24", "until": null, "start": "19:00", "minutes": 45, "cancelled": [], "title": {"en": ..., "ru": ...}, "location": {...}, "map": "...", "notes": {...}}.

description.en: Runs of Limassol Seafront Run. New runs and changes appear automatically.
description.ru: Тренировки Limassol Seafront Run. Новые пробежки и изменения появляются автоматически.

title.en: Limassol Seafront Run: first run (3 km)
title.ru: Limassol Seafront Run: первая тренировка (3 км)

location.en: Opposite Dream Tower, blue public sports ground on the seafront, Limassol
location.ru: Напротив Dream Tower, синяя общественная спортплощадка на набережной, Лимассол

notes.en: A shorter 3 km to start. About 45 minutes including warm-up and cool-down. Free, every pace welcome. Bring a friend: they can register at the start via the QR code.
notes.ru: Для начала короче, 3 км. Около 45 минут вместе с разминкой и заминкой. Бесплатно, любой темп. Зовите друга: он зарегистрируется на старте по QR-коду.
